title: Airla Fan — spatial globe portfolio
note: Sixteen project thumbnails form a slowly rotating 3D globe; drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, and hovering a thumbnail dims unrelated work while dotted lines arc to related projects by category colour. She rated it 6/10 taste, 6/10 cool — concept stronger than execution. Her steal: one project connected to multiple themes instead of forced into one filter bucket, executed cleaner with titles and an Index visible from the start. LinkedIn post: https://lnkd.in/p/eNDcHuDy — captured date is approximate (month only on record).
